errors.text_span: 水平轴表示模型名称，其刻度为分类的，标签为模型名称，顺序为 Ours、GPT-4 和 Claude3。
errors.evidence: The description first lists the models and their order in the first sentence ('模型分别为“Ours”、“GPT-4”和“Claude3”，并按此顺序从左至右排列。'), and then immediately repeats this information in the next sentence when describing the horizontal axis. This repetition is unnecessary.
